Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: drone platform
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Stores material and spends it to deploy drones.\n\nRetracting a drone returns it to the platform and refunds the material it cost. Deployed drones obey the allowed area set on the platform, and every drone controlled by the platform shuts down if the platform is destroyed. Platforms that support several unit types let you choose which one to deploy, and can be set to deploy and recall automatically on a fixed interval.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: drone
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A remotely operated unit bound to its deployment platform. \n\nDrone can only be controlled while the platform is powered and under your control, or for a wearable platform, while the wearer is drafted on the same map. It runs on an internal battery and automatically returns to the platform when the charge runs low; use the return command to recall it early and recover the material it cost. Drones deployed by you drop their equipment when destroyed.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: drone pack
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A wearable drone platform. The wearer can release its drones. for NPC-controlled wearers, they will use it on their own when hostiles are present on the map.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: contact detonation
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: When this unit lands a melee attack it detonates every explosive it is carrying or holding, destroying itself in the process. Hostile units of this type may spawn carrying explosives.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: field recycling
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Once this unit is downed or destroyed it can be dismantled where it lies. Mark it for recycling, or order a colonist directly, and they will take it apart on the spot, dropping any gear it carried and leaving behind part of the materials it was built from. Wrecks yield less than downed units.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: humanlike mechanoid
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A mechanoid built on an ergonomic humanlike frame. It can wear apparel and benefits from its effects, while still counting as a mechanoid for control, repair and bandwidth.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: weapon systems
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This mechanoid can pick up and use weapons. Which weapons it accepts is limited by its model's filters — weapon tags, tech level, weapon class, or an explicit whitelist — or by the weapon's own body size requirement. The full list is shown under the mechanoid's weapon systems entry.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: turret operation
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This mechanoid can man turrets and other crewed emplacements just like a colonist; whether a given emplacement can be operated is defined by its weapon systems.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: hibernation
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This Mechanoid can put into hibernation. It becomes a dormant structure that no longer uses bandwidth and can later be reactivated by any mechanitor with enough free bandwidth. It cannot be hibernated while downed.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: deactivated mechanoid
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A deactivated mechanoid in storage. A mechanitor with enough free bandwidth can take control of it directly; hostile or unowned units can instead be hacked by a colonist with research work enabled. A failed hack wakes the mech up hostile. It can also be scrapped.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: hibernatable mechanoid
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A mechanoid that can temporary shutdown for storage. Hibernating mechs use no control bandwidth and can be restarted by a mechanitor with enough bandwidth; if it belongs to someone else it can be hacked by a colonist. Mothballed mechs found in the wild may sometimes still be holding their weapon.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: overseer unit
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A mechanoid that commands other mechanoids on its own, with its own bandwidth and control groups, and needs no mechanitor. Mechanoids placed under its control obey it as they would a mechanitor and follow it in the field. It can restart mothballed mechanoids it comes across, and repair the mechs it oversees while they are nearby.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: overseer core
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A stationary command structure with its own bandwidth and control groups. Mechanoids assigned to it obey it as they would a mechanitor within its command range — some cores cover the whole map. It can restart mothballed mechanoids directly, and repair the mechs it oversees while they are nearby. Linked facilities extend its capabilities.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: dead man's switch
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This mechanoid carries a fail-safe that terminates it if it is ever cut off from its overseer. Units that are lost or wander off may still find their way home — but occasionally the switch fails to reset.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: artificial life
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A bio-engineered artificial living construct. Its wounds regenerate over time on their own, and when its energy runs low it can eat to recharge instead of needing a charger.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: self-repair
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: While this condition is present the mechanoid slowly repairs its own damage over time without a mechanitor.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: ceramic plating
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Disposable armor with its own hit points. Incoming damage is absorbed by the plating until its durability is exhausted, after which it breaks and must be replaced. Larger mechs can carry more plates.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: mech modification
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This item is a modification module for mechanoids. Open a mech's modification window, pick a body slot and queue the install; a colonist then fits it. Each slot holds one module, and some modules can be stacked or merged up to a limit. Modules can be removed later.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: command relay
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: A command unit. It ignores its mechanitor's control range entirely, and other mechanoids near it are treated as within range as well. On expeditions away from the mechanitor the relay radius shrinks with distance on the world map, down to a minimum once too far away. While drafted it shows its current coverage on the map.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: control relay
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: Extends mechanoid control range around it — for every mechanitor, not just one. As a building it works while powered, in working order and owned by your colony; as apparel it works while worn by one of your pawns. Some relays cover the whole map. The coverage ring is shown while a drafted mech is selected.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: signal attenuation
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: While drafted, this mechanoid's performance depends on how far it is from its mechanitor. Close by it suffers little; the further away, the heavier the penalty, reaching its worst when the mechanitor is on another map. The penalty clears as soon as the mech is undrafted.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: weapon imprint
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: The first weapon this mechanoid equips is imprinted into its adaptive systems. The longer it keeps using that weapon type the higher its imprint level grows, granting increasing bonuses; switching to a different weapon type discards the imprint.

Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.label: apparel support
Fortified.FFF_InfoDef.description: This mechanoid can wear apparel. Some apparel layers are blocked by its frame and cannot be equipped.
